explainer_content.short_definition: Post-2010 R&B that sounds intimate, atmospheric, genre-fluid, and internet-era personal.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Alt-R&B grew as artists pulled R&B into indie, electronic, hip-hop, and bedroom-production spaces, making mood and self-narration central.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It reset R&B prestige for the streaming era and influenced pop's sound of vulnerability and atmosphere.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The track may feel sparse, fractured, or suspended, but the vocal emotion remains R&B-rooted.
